issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: zCAD AI
products.tagline: AI 3D that creates real parts, not just shapes
products.summaryZh: AI 3D 创造真实零件，而不只是形状
products.descriptionZh: zCAD. AI 是一个 AI 原生平台，用于生成参数化 3D 模型，面向设计师、创客和工程师。用自然语言描述零件或装配体，zCAD. AI 即可生成可编辑、尺寸驱动的 3D 模型，基于真实 CAD 几何构建，而非静态网格。• 通过单条提示完成装配体，并包含零件间的配合关系 • 用自然语言细化，或在基于浏览器的 CAD 编辑器中编辑尺寸 • 导出为 STEP，以便在任何 CAD 工具中使用
products.description: zCAD. AI is an AI-native platform for generating parametric 3D models, built for designers, makers and engineers. Describe a part or assembly in plain language, and zCAD. AI generates an editable, dimension-driven 3D model built on real CAD geometry, not a static mesh. • Complete assemblies from a single prompt, with mates between parts • Refine in plain language, or edit dimensions in a browser-based CAD editor • Export to STEP for use in any CAD tool

products.name: myPip
products.tagline: Vibe code, publish, and monetize games with AI
products.summaryZh: 用AI编写代码、发布游戏并实现盈利
products.descriptionZh: MyPip 将你的游戏创意转化为可发布、可变现的可玩游戏。描述你想构建的内容，AI 直接在浏览器中将其变为现实，无需编程。创建多人游戏体验，添加应用内购买和广告，并让你的游戏走出浏览器，触达更多玩家。从最初的创意到发布与变现，MyPip 为任何人提供成为游戏创作者的工具。
products.description: MyPip turns your game ideas into playable games you can publish and monetize. Describe what you want to build, and AI brings it to life directly in your browser, no coding required. Create multiplayer experiences, add in-app purchases and ads, and take your games beyond the browser to reach more players. From your first idea to publishing and monetization, MyPip gives anyone the tools to become a game creator.

products.name: 1Password for Agents
products.tagline: Let AI agents sign in for you without seeing your passwords
products.summaryZh: 让 AI 代理替你登录，无需看到你的密码
products.descriptionZh: 1Password for Agents 让受支持的 AI 代理登录你的账户，全程不会看到你的密码。当代理遇到登录环节时，它会向 1Password 发起请求。你在自己的设备上批准或拒绝，1Password 会直接填入密码或一次性验证码。连接代理并不会开放你的整个密码库。该功能包含在 Individual 和 Family 套餐中，Meta Muse 和 Grok Bot 正在逐步推出，并设有等候名单。
products.description: 1Password for Agents lets supported AI agents sign in to your accounts without ever seeing your passwords. When an agent hits a login, it asks 1Password. You approve or deny on your own device, and 1Password fills the password or one-time code directly. Connecting an agent doesn’t open your whole vault. Included in Individual and Family plans, with Meta Muse and Grok Bot rolling out and a waitlist.

products.name: AgentValley
products.tagline: Every Claude Code agent, at a glance, in your Mac's notch
products.summaryZh: 每个 Claude Code 代理，一目了然，就在你的 Mac 刘海屏上
products.descriptionZh: 它就在你的 MacBook 刘海处。每个 Claude Code 会话都有一张卡片，每个子代理都有一行，每一行都有一个像素小人程序员。你能看到谁在工作、用的是哪个模型，以及谁在等你。免费且开源。
products.description: It sits in your MacBook's notch. Every Claude Code session gets a card, every sub-agent gets a row, and each one has a little pixel programmer. You see who's working, on which model, and who's waiting on you. Free and open source.

products.name: Canva Craft
products.tagline: Turn prompts into design-ready images you can edit
products.summaryZh: 将提示词转化为可编辑的、可直接用于设计的图像
products.descriptionZh: Canva Craft 是 Canva 首个自研图像模型，专为营销人员、创作者和设计师打造，满足他们对可作为设计而非单纯图片的图像的需求。与主要基于照片训练、直接从提示词渲染像素的模型不同，Craft 从数百万 Canva 模板中学习，先规划构图，再以 2K 分辨率、30 多种宽高比进行渲染。支持 55 种语言的可读文本、精准布局，输出可拆分为可编辑图层。现已在 Canva 上线，并提供 API。
products.description: Canva Craft is Canva’s first in-house image model, built for marketers, creators and designers who need images that work as designs, not just pictures. Unlike models trained mostly on photos that render pixels straight from a prompt, Craft learned from millions of Canva templates and plans the composition first, then renders it at 2K in 30+ aspect ratios. Expect legible text in 55 languages, precise placement and outputs you can split into editable layers. Live in Canva today, plus API.

products.name: LinkIntel
products.tagline: Post insights delivered direct to your AI
products.summaryZh: 帖子洞察直接发送至你的人工智能
products.descriptionZh: 你的 AI 已经能帮你起草 X 帖子，但它从未见过这些帖子的表现如何。LinkIntel 解决了这个问题。只需连接一次 X，它就会每天记录你近期帖子的表现。它还会每天读取 X 的开源排名权重，并将每一处变更关联到对应的 GitHub 提交。在 Claude、ChatGPT 或你常用的 agent harness 中添加一个 URL，然后请求一份简报：你的下一份草稿将基于真正对你有效的内容。
products.description: Your AI already drafts your X posts, but it has never seen how they performed. LinkIntel fixes that. Connect X once and it records how your recent posts do, every day. It also reads X's open-source ranking weights daily and links every change to its GitHub commit. Add one URL to Claude, ChatGPT, or your favorite agent harness and ask for a brief: your next draft starts from what actually worked for you

products.name: Many Displays
products.tagline: Zero clicks: windows back after sleep, unlock or replugging
products.summaryZh: 零点击：睡眠、解锁或重新插拔后窗口恢复
products.descriptionZh: 无需保存，无需命名布局，无需点击。Many Displays 会默默记住每个窗口的位置（显示器、位置、大小），并在你的 Mac 唤醒、解锁或重新连接显示器时自动将一切恢复原状。只需授予一次辅助功能权限，之后便可忘掉它的存在。专为 macOS 总是混淆的相同显示器而打造：它能区分它们，甚至能通过所插入的端口来辨别。无云端，无账户。一次性付费 19 美元，14 天免费试用。
products.description: Nothing to save, no layouts to name, nothing to click. Many Displays quietly remembers where every window lives (display, position, size) and puts everything back on its own when your Mac wakes, unlocks or reconnects its monitors. Grant Accessibility once and forget it's there. Built for identical monitors that macOS keeps swapping: it tells them apart, even by the port they're plugged into. No cloud, no account. $19 one-time, 14-day free trial.

products.name: Penta
products.tagline: A ’90s 5-disc CD changer on iPhone Duo
products.summaryZh: iPhone Duo 上的 90 年代 5 碟 CD 换碟机
products.descriptionZh: Penta 把你的 iPhone、iPad 或 iPhone Duo 变成一台 90 年代的五碟 CD 换碟机，用来播放你的 Apple Music 曲库。每一次咔哒声、转动声和托盘电机声都录制自真实的 CD 换碟机。在 iPhone Duo 上，手机就是唱片盒：合上它，你手里拿着的就是专辑；打开它，唱片盒也随之打开，然后把光盘放入转盘。将它竖直握持，托盘上方会显示一个 CD 收纳包，并带有开合动画。免费使用，可选一次性 Pro 解锁，获得真实印刷的 CD 封面图。
products.description: Penta turns your iPhone, iPad or iPhone Duo into a ’90s 5-disc CD changer for your Apple Music library. Every click, whir and tray motor is recorded from a real CD changer. On iPhone Duo the phone is the jewel case: close it and you’re holding the album, open it and the case opens with it, then drop the disc into the carousel. Hold it upright for a CD wallet over the tray that animates open and closed. Free, with an optional one-time Pro unlock for the real printed CD art.

products.name: Byter
products.tagline: Know exactly how much data you use, on every network
products.summaryZh: 准确掌握你在每个网络上使用的数据量
products.descriptionZh: Byter 显示你使用了多少互联网数据以及用在哪里。它分别追踪每个 Wi‑Fi 网络、手机热点和有线连接的使用情况，让你确切知道热点流量花在了哪里。你还能获得实时速度、一键速度测试、从每日到每年的图表，以及使用量激增时的温和提醒。一切数据都保留在你的设备上。无需账户，无广告。现已推出 Mac 版，Windows 版即将推出，支持 11 种语言。
products.description: Byter shows how much internet data you use, and where. It tracks usage separately for every Wi‑Fi network, phone hotspot and wired connection, so you know exactly what your hotspot bundle went on. You also get live speed, a one-click speed test, daily-to-yearly charts, and gentle alerts when usage spikes. Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads. Available now for Mac, Windows coming soon, in 11 languages.

products.name: Basedash Scheduled CSV Exports
products.tagline: Ask once. Get a fresh CSV in Slack or email every week.
products.summaryZh: 只需一次设置，每周即可在 Slack 或邮箱收到全新的 CSV 文件。
products.descriptionZh: Basedash 自动化现在可以发送 CSV 导出文件。把它写进指令——“每周一发送上周新注册用户的 CSV”——每次运行都会根据你的数据生成该文件。在 Slack 中，CSV 会附在消息的线程里；邮件和自动化的运行历史中会提供“下载 CSV”链接。下载通过 Basedash 进行，因此接收者需要拥有该自动化的访问权限才能打开。请求一次，每周获取 CSV。
products.description: Basedash automations can now send CSV exports. Write it into the instructions — "send a CSV of last week's new signups every Monday" — and each run builds the file from your data. In Slack, the CSV is attached in the message's thread; emails and the automation's run history get a Download CSV link. Downloads go through Basedash, so recipients need access to the automation to open them. Ask for it once. Get the CSV every week.

products.name: sideOS.ai
products.tagline: Local AI for dictation, meetings, background tasks and more
products.summaryZh: 本地AI，用于听写、会议、后台任务等
products.descriptionZh: sideOS 驻留在 Mac 的刘海区域。按住 Control + Option，说出你的需求，然后松开！它会读取你的屏幕、打开应用、点击、输入，并在完成后告知你。可完全离线运行本地模型，或使用你自己的 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini 或 Grok 密钥。
products.description: sideOS lives in your Mac’s notch. Hold Control + Option, say what you want, let go! It reads your screen, opens apps, clicks, types and tells you when it’s done. Run it fully offline local models or use your own Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or Grok key.

products.name: River Writer
products.tagline: A quiet Mac app for screenplays, stage plays and novels
products.summaryZh: 一款适用于剧本、舞台剧和小说创作的安静Mac应用
products.descriptionZh: River Writer 是一款免费的 Mac 应用，适用于剧本、舞台剧和小说创作。你以纯文本（.fountain 或 md）写作，实时预览会在旁边显示格式化、可直接打印的页面：剧本、多机位、舞台剧或手稿。内置 Git 版本控制，因此你可以提交草稿、恢复文件，并在分支上尝试另一种结局。大纲、便笺和待办事项以纯文件形式存放在你的项目中。无账户、无云端、无遥测、无 AI；它不建立任何网络连接。开源（MIT）。
products.description: River Writer is a free Mac app for screenplays, stage plays and novels. You write plain text (.fountain ormd) and a live preview shows the formatted, print-ready pages beside it: Screenplay, Multi-cam, Stage Play or Manuscript. Git versioning is built in, so you can commit drafts, restore files and try an alternate ending on a branch. Outline, scratchpad and todos live as plain files in your project. No accounts, cloud, telemetry or AI; it makes no network connections. Open source (MIT).

products.name: How It Went
products.tagline: Your route, photos and clips as a short film
products.summaryZh: 你的路线、照片和片段，汇成一部短片
products.descriptionZh: 把一次骑行或整段旅程变成一部短片，素材来自你已有的 GPS 轨迹、照片和片段。轨迹会在倾斜的地图上自行绘制，每张照片出现在拍摄地点，片段在拍摄处播放。可从 Strava 选取骑行记录，或导入 Garmin FIT 和 GPX 文件。多天内容合并为一部影片，休息日也包含在内。校正一次相机时钟错误，该相机拍摄的每个镜头都会随之调整。最终输出 MP4，9:16 或 16:9，在你的 iPhone、Android 手机或 Mac 上完成组装和编码。
products.description: Turns one ride or a whole trip into a short film from the GPS track, photos and clips you already have. Your track draws itself across a tilted map, each photo appears where you took it, and clips play where they were shot. Pick rides from Strava or bring Garmin FIT and GPX files. Several days merge into one film, rest days included. Fix a wrong camera clock once and every shot from it moves. Out comes an MP4, 9:16 or 16:9, assembled and encoded on your iPhone, Android phone or Mac.

products.name: Shedi
products.tagline: Get back the space Xcode, Docker and node_modules ate
products.summaryZh: 找回被Xcode、Docker和node_modules占用的空间
products.descriptionZh: 诚实的Mac清理工具。Shedi能找出Xcode、Docker、node_modules以及20多种包管理器在你Mac上留下的内容，说明每一项是什么、是否会再次出现，并且只清理你选中的项目。所有内容都会先移到废纸篓。一次付费。
products.description: The honest Mac cleaner. Shedi finds what Xcode, Docker, node_modules and 20+ package managers left on your Mac, says what each item is and whether it comes back, and cleans only what you pick. Everything goes to the Trash first. Pay once.

products.name: Laylight
products.tagline: Get the full picture
products.summaryZh: 了解全貌
products.descriptionZh: Laylight 连接公司现有的工具，让你能在一个地方查看整个业务的运行情况。它通过自动化重复性任务、协调团队工作，并让管理层更清楚地了解正在发生的事情，帮助团队节省时间。
products.description: Laylight connects your company’s existing tools so you can see what’s happening across your business in one place. It helps teams save time by automating repetitive tasks, coordinating their work and giving management greater visibility into what’s going on.

products.name: Fluxix
products.tagline: Control what your AI agents can access, run, and spend
products.summaryZh: 控制你的AI代理可以访问、运行和花费的范围
products.descriptionZh: AI代理可以调用API、访问数据库并转移资金。但一个错误的操作就可能造成严重损失。Fluxix在代理与系统之间加入安全层，在执行每个操作前进行检查。用通俗英语设定规则，阻止高风险操作，要求人工审批，并保护敏感数据。每个决策都会被记录，让你在不拖慢代理的情况下保持掌控。
products.description: AI agents can call APIs, access databases, and move money. But one wrong action can cause serious damage. Fluxix puts a safety layer between your agents and your systems, checking every action before it happens. Set rules in plain English, block risky operations, require human approval, and protect sensitive data. Every decision is logged, so you stay in control without slowing your agents down.

products.name: Kept
products.tagline: Turn ideas into action. AI planner: tasks, notes, calendar
products.summaryZh: 将想法转化为行动。AI规划器：任务、笔记、日历
products.descriptionZh: 我打造了这款应用，希望它能融合 Notion、Craft Notes 和 Things 3 的理想体验。这款应用与 Product Hunt 上众多待办事项应用的不同之处在于：- 目标追踪功能让应用围绕帮助你真正实现高效目标而构建，而不是让你自己去做整理工作。- 待办事项利用设备上的 Apple Intelligence 自动将任务分类到你定义的领域中[便于日后轻松搜索]- 集成的日历、任务和笔记可在 iPhone 和 Mac 上运行并同步。
products.description: I built what I wish Notion, Craft Notes, and Things 3 felt like together. What makes this app different from the many todo apps on product hunt: - Goal tracking makes the app built around helping you actually achieve your productive goals, rather than making you do the work of being organized yourself. - Todos use Apple Intelligence on device to auto sort tasks into areas that you define [making them easily searchable later] - Integrated calendar, tasks, and notes work and sync on iPhone, Mac.

products.name: Surveys in Claude and ChatGPT
products.tagline: Build surveys in Claude and ChatGPT, keep answers private
products.summaryZh: 在Claude和ChatGPT中创建调查问卷，答案保持私密
products.descriptionZh: 将 BlockSurvey 连接到 Claude、Claude Code 或 ChatGPT。描述你需要的调查，即可在同一聊天中收到实时链接。通过提问来修改问题。回答保持端到端加密，因此你的 AI 助手始终无法看到它们。
products.description: Connect BlockSurvey to Claude, Claude Code or ChatGPT. Describe the survey you need and get a live link back in the same chat. Change questions by asking. Responses stay end-to-end encrypted, so your AI assistant never sees them.

products.name: gethome
products.tagline: Smart home on a hub you own, with AI that writes the rules
products.summaryZh: 智能家居运行在您自有的中枢上，由AI编写规则
products.descriptionZh: 用你拥有的中枢——一台小型计算机，比如树莓派，在你自己的 Wi-Fi 上——通过原生 iPhone App 管理你的家。配对 Zigbee 和 Matter 设备，向助手提问，描述一条规则让 AI agent 来编写。AI 运行在你自己的 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 密钥上。
products.description: Run your home from a native iPhone app on a hub you own — a small computer such as a Raspberry Pi, on your own Wi-Fi. Pair Zigbee and Matter devices, ask the assistant, and describe a rule for an AI agent to write. AI runs on your own Anthropic or OpenAI key.

products.name: GlossPage: Translate and Read
products.tagline: Translate manga, comics, books, PDFs
products.summaryZh: 翻译漫画、漫画书、书籍、PDF文件
products.descriptionZh: 翻译照片、书籍、漫画和 PDF。双语对照阅读。通过轻点背面或操作按钮，在任意应用中捕捉并翻译文本，即使是无法复制的文本也能翻译。
products.description: Translate photos, books, manga and PDFs. Read both languages together. Capture and translate text in any app with Back Tap or the Action Button, even text you can’t copy.
